about_the_game:
The Legend of Sahur

An epic adventure about love, courage, and hope.

Play as TUNG TUNG TUNG SAHUR, the brave stickman on a journey to rescue his beloved Ballerina Cappuccina from the clutches of the powerful Deer King, Luguanluguanlulushijiandaole.

Along the way, you’ll travel through forest towns, scorching deserts, battle cities, misty tree seas, and the eerie Deer Castle. Meet a cast of unforgettable allies—
including your long-lost brother Ta Ta Ta Sahur, the ocean-powered three-legged shark Tralalero Tralala, your lover’s ex-boyfriend Cappuccino Assassino, and the ever-energetic orange warrior U Din Din Din Din Dun Ma Din Din Din Dun.

To save your beloved, you must defeat the guardian who commands the power of time itself—only then can you confront the Deer King and his unstoppable time-freezing magic.

Key Features:

  • Story-driven adventure blending humor and action

  • A diverse cast of companions and side quests

  • Choices that shape the story and determine the ending

  • Explore five unique regions and uncover hidden truths

Are you ready to pick up your stick and challenge fate?
